news.title: Supertanker Rates Plunge More Than 60% From Record Highs
news.summary: The cost of shipping oil in the largest tankers has declined sharply since the beginning of November, reflecting weaker demand for chartering and an unwinding of the geopolitical risk premium that sent shipping costs to a record high in October.
